meta.times: seconds; keys ending in _min are minutes only in results
meta.calibration: priors from S2/S6/orchestrator-report; M3 replaces measured where possible (M1 §2)
meta.note: sim.py reads every knob from this file — nothing is hardcoded in the model

peak._source: S6 §1: measured session ran at peak pricing (peak = 2x DeepSeek prices)

graph._source: S2 §2: dependency edges (interface/data/migration order); measured portfolio ~6-16 specs, sparse DAG

portfolio._source: S2 §2 granularity: 1-8 scope paths per contract; observed cross-contract overlap (install.sh, G2 vs S4)

lanes._source: oh-my-opencode-slim.json defaultConcurrency=2 (S2 §4); batch drafting then incremental execute (S2 §3)

draft._source: assumption ~12 min/spec; draft sessions are 200-290k ctx (report §3), time-boxed lanes

suite._source: CALIBRATED: 16 contracts x (1 suite + 8 locals) ~= 854 s = 14.2 min, matches measured 14 min full wave (README §5-P1.4) and M3 R9 dedup potential -63%; suite class aggregates pytest-e2e/ctest (M3 R10: mean 22-42 s)

local._source: CALIBRATED with suite: 155 checks/wave = 9.7/contract (M3 R5/R17); local class ~ pytest-unit/static (M3 R10: 0.01-1.0 s)

flake_backoff._source: S2 §3: retry backoff d0=2 s..; re-run of one check

approval_per_item._source: assumption 5 min/approve; >=12 manual approves/session measured (report F2)

approval_collect._source: batch debounce: wait for the draft batch (--all), then one sitting

detect._source: CALIBRATED so first-pass DoD rate ~= 80% (S6 §3 alert <80%); full detect=0.964, sampled=0.586; M3 R3 shows recorded final evidence is 100% green, so the true first-pass rate is unmeasured — prior is conservative, see report limitations

contention._source: laptop 6 cores, loadavg 26.68 (AGENTS.md): H>1 adds port/build contention

r6._source: R6: <=3 attempts, then stop-and-ask; second consult forces resolution

rework._source: F1: 3 rounds of batch edits each invalidating approval; file-ownership collision install.sh (report §4.1); p_fix = fixer success on first rework (assumption)

shallow._source: PRIOR (no data, M1 open Q1): out-of-scope coupling (toolchain/fixture) missed by scope-shallow staleness; sensitivity sweep provided

sampling._source: M1 §3-E: risk stratification; touched core/seccomp always full

costs_usd._source: MEASURED: 6 draft sessions ~= $0.70 ($0.117 each), 18 subagent sessions ~= $1.00 ($0.056 avg); check/wave = supervision cost estimate

A.label: status quo: full DoD per contract, global re-wave, per-contract approve

B.label: dedup DoD + stateless wave-run + batch approve

B+C+D.label: target factory: dedup + shallow + parallel envs
